# by Urška

> by Urška is the home of Urška Repušič, a Slovenian painter and poet from Rače and a former European bouldering champion who traded the rock for the canvas. The site sells her original paintings (shipping from Slovenia to the EU and worldwide) and brings together five worlds: art, poetry, spirituality, climbing and finance.

## Art

- [Art](https://www.byurska.com/art): original paintings, a storytelling gallery of mood, memory and light.
- [Collection](https://www.byurska.com/collection): the complete collection, including Blossoming Love, The Prophecy, Eternal Love, Birds of Light, Somehow My Heart Still Remembers You, Voice of the Night, Wild Spirit and Becoming.
- [About](https://www.byurska.com/about): the story, philosophy and process behind the paintings.

## Poetry and spirituality

- [Poetry](https://www.byurska.com/poetry): one of Urška's own poems every week, free, with one of her paintings beside it.
- [Spirituality](https://www.byurska.com/spirituality): card of the day, the moon today, a minute of stillness, a gratitude practice and live tarot readings with Urška.
- [Zvezdni poslovni koledar](https://www.byurska.com/zvezdni-koledar): a personal astrological calendar for business and life (in Slovenian), 7 days free, then €1 a month.
- [Manifest by Urška](https://www.byurska.com/lumora): Urška's manifesting app for iPhone, a card every morning and a question every evening; 7 days free, then €1.99 a month.

## Climb and finance

- [Climb](https://www.byurska.com/climb): the years as a European bouldering champion before the canvas.
- [Finance](https://www.byurska.com/finance): a degree in finance, and the markets learned in practice on [My Edge Official](https://www.myedgeofficial.com).
